targetText: The social revolution can come only in the form of an epoch in which are combined civil war by the proletariat against the bourgeoisie in the advanced countries and a whole series of democratic and revolutionary movements, including the national liberation movement, in the undeveloped, backward and oppressed nations.
summary: Lenin outlines the global architecture of socialist revolution: an entire historical epoch that unites working-class revolutions in advanced capitalist states with anti-colonial national liberation revolts in the oppressed periphery.
